lines.t: O Maker of earth and opener of heavens,
You who stretched the void and called forth light,
foundations laid beneath uncharted waters,
matrix woven by Your sovereign might.
From hidden chambers deep within creation,
minute designs no mortal eye can trace,
You see and know each secret, every measure,
beholding all before Your timeless face.
No distance dares escape Your boundless vision,
no weight too great, no burden You can't bear,
vast galaxies bow low before Your wisdom,
morning by morning, finding all things there.
Kingdoms You raise from dust and bring to ruin,
covering earth with beauty none can steal,
stars fixed eternal by Your hand commanding,
every orbit turned upon Your wheel.
[Chorus] (gentle fingerpicking swells)
O Great I AM, forever reigning sovereign!
Power without measure, wisdom never failing!
Thrones rise and crumble at Your mighty word alone,
YAHUSHUA YAHUWAH—You sit upon the throne!
Infinite in glory, absolute, unchanging,
all creation lifts its voice in holy praise,
from everlasting foundations to eternal skies,
to You alone be glory through endless days!
You who were and are and ever shall be coming,
unchanging through the ages, always true,
before Your face all measures find their meaning,
the whole of time and space lives within You.
every orbit turned upon Your wheel.
[Chorus] (gentle fingerpicking swells)
O Great I AM, forever reigning sovereign!
Power without measure, wisdom never failing!
Thrones rise and crumble at Your mighty word alone,
YAHUSHUA YAHUWAH—You sit upon the throne!
Infinite in glory, absolute, unchanging,
all creation lifts its voice in holy praise,
from everlasting foundations to eternal skies,
to You alone be glory through endless days!
You who were and are and ever shall be coming,
unchanging through the ages, always true,
before Your face all measures find their meaning,
the whole of time and space lives within You.
Praise to the One who formed the earth's foundation!
Praise to the Word by which all things consist!
Praise to the Name that stands through every nation!
YAHUSHUA YAHUWAH—forever blessed!
O Lord Most High... You formed... You know... You reign...
Great I AM... from everlasting... to everlasting... Amen.
